head_coach.name: Julen Lopetegui
head_coach.play_style_summary: Focused on possession-based control, structural defensive discipline, compact organization, and tactical flexibility in transitions.

key_players.name: Akram Afif
key_players.performance_stats: Two-time Asian Footballer of the Year (2019, 2023); chief creative force and playmaker who led Qatar to historic direct qualification for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

key_players.name: Almoez Ali
key_players.performance_stats: Qatar's all-time top goalscorer who recently returned from a long-term injury; scored 12 goals during the AFC World Cup qualification campaign.

key_players.name: Edmílson Junior
key_players.performance_stats: Highly technical naturalized winger offering exceptional width, dribbling ability, and clinical depth in attacking transitions.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: No major injuries or suspensions currently reported. The entire 35-man preliminary squad is fully fit and participating in training camps ahead of their preparatory friendlies.
